text:
maya (Partnerships): Quick thread — proposing a cohort-based launch pricing + renewal ladder for marketplace listings with HW & SI bundles. Want input on discounts, commit sizing, and joint-announce cadence.
aj (Sales): Nice, high-level summary please. do we need new SKUs? :eyes:
maya (Partnerships): Two cohorts idea: Pilot (3–6 months) + Scale (12 months). Pilot gets larger intro discount to drive proofs, Scale has lower discount but better commit terms. No new SKUs initially, just billing masks.
liam (Product): paste the tiers? also call out reserved-capacity interaction so infra teams see it.
maya (Partnerships): ```
TIERS:
- PILOT: 35% off list, min commit $25k over 3mo, onboarding credit $5k (one-time)
- SCALE: 20% off list, 12mo commit, annual true-up, onboarding credit $2k
RENEWAL LADDER:
- Y1->Y2: discount reduces by 10ppt if consumption met
- Y2->Y3: reduces additional 5ppt, with option to move to dedicated plan
```
serena (Finance): Heads up — revenue recognition for the $25k pilot commit needs proration rules. Also need to model churn impact if onboarding credit is applied up-front. I'll take point on ARR math.
aj (Sales): For HW partners: recommend a co-sell margin pool (8–12%) carved from our margin, and a small HW cross-credit (applies only to SCALE). Can we make the HW credit redeemable against Dedicated capacity only?
chirag (Solutions): SI bundles need clear deliverable windows. Proposal: SI gets a 30 day enablement credit (discounted tokens + co-marketing) after they sign the integration checklist. That credit shouldn't stack with Pilot onboarding credit.
liam (Product): Operational question: how will the marketplace UI show the ladder? we should show "Intro price" and "Renewal guidance" so customers know expected step-down. Also add an FAQ entry.
maya (Partnerships): Joint announcement flow: partners need signed LOA 2 weeks before public; we coordinate assets T-6 weeks (blog + partner quote + one-pager), legal reviews at T-2. Suggested runbook: 1) Post LOA -> partner field enablement -> assets final -> joint announce.
ops (Eng): ops checklist — pricing config validated in sandbox, SAML SCIM tokens for SI provisioning, and billing hooks tested. I can run validation next Wed.
dev-announcer-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing draft saved: https://redwood.docs/marketplace/launch-cohort-draft (owner: maya).
aj (Sales): one more ask — renewal incentive: if customer upgrades to Dedicated within first 9 months, offer a one-time credit equal to 50% of onboarding credit. Helps convert Pilot proofs.
maya (Partnerships): Great. Action items: Maya: finalize pricing table + playbook (due Tue). Serena: ARR model + PR impact (due Thu). Chirag: SI enablement checklist (due Fri). Aj/LIAM: confirm HW credit gating (sync tomorrow). Any objections? :tada:
